# Changelog v0.11.0

Release Date: 2026-11-20

## 🔌 API

- Spread search hits across documents and add citation fields. (see PR [#5809](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/5809)) - See [API changes](./api.md)
- Read and list documents, keep generations past deletes. (see PR [#5843](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/5843)) - See [API changes](./api.md)
- Export/import namespaces and list/drop namespaces in @qvac/rag. (see PR [#5844](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/5844)) - See [API changes](./api.md)

## ⚙️ Infrastructure

- Move the SDK pod onto the package CI contract. (see PR [#5466](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/5466))
